content.value_statement: Agents often need spreadsheet logic without controlling Excel. This skill guides MCP and TypeScript workflows for WorkPaper formulas, file-backed edits, and local XLSX formula reports.
actual_capabilities: Configure a WorkPaper MCP server with npm exec and argument arrays.
List file-backed tools for reading, writing, exporting, and validating cells.
Show direct TypeScript usage of @bilig/headless WorkPaper APIs.
Guide local XLSX formula clinic reports for reduced workbook bugs.
Define verification evidence after editing formulas or cells.
limitations: Does not automate Excel UI, macros, VBA, pivots, or charts.
Does not claim exact Excel desktop behavior without an explicit comparison task.
Requires the host to run npm or TypeScript tooling for examples.
Requests reduced public fixtures instead of private customer spreadsheets.

use_cases.title: Build pricing workbook logic
use_cases.description: Model quote, budget, payout, or forecast formulas in WorkPaper state and verify recalculated cells.

use_cases.title: Expose workbook edits through MCP
use_cases.description: Configure file-backed MCP tools so agents can read, update, validate, and export workbook state.

use_cases.title: Report formula import bugs
use_cases.description: Create a local formula clinic report from a reduced XLSX fixture with specific cells.

prompt_templates.title: Start a WorkPaper edit
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a local workbook file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Bilig WorkPaper skill to inspect my local pricing workbook, list the sheets, and explain which cells need verification.

prompt_templates.title: Configure MCP tools
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate setup for file-backed agent access.
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up a WorkPaper MCP workflow for my forecast workbook using argument arrays. Include the tools I should call after each write.

prompt_templates.title: Verify formula changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Change an input cell, read the dependent summary cell, export the WorkPaper state, and report before and after values.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a formula clinic report
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced bug report for reduced XLSX fixtures.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the formula clinic workflow for my reduced XLSX file. Focus on named cells and produce a concise local report summary.

output_examples.input: Update a pricing model so customer count changes and revenue recalculates.
output_examples.output: The response identifies the edited input cell, shows prior and updated revenue values, and confirms exported WorkPaper persistence.

output_examples.input: Diagnose a reduced XLSX formula import issue for two important cells.
output: The response names the reduced fixture and target cells.
It summarizes the local formula clinic result.
It notes unsupported formulas or compatibility limits when relevant.

best_practices: Validate workbook paths and cell references before using them in tool arguments.
Read dependent output cells after every write and include before and after values.
Use reduced public fixtures when reporting XLSX formula issues.
anti_patterns: Concatenating user text into shell commands.
Claiming edits succeeded without reading recalculated outputs.
Uploading private spreadsheets or using full customer workbooks for bug reports.

faq.question: Does this skill automate Excel?
faq.answer: No. It works with Bilig WorkPaper state and does not drive the Excel desktop interface.

faq.question: Can it edit workbook files through MCP?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes file-backed MCP tools for reading, writing, validating, and exporting WorkPaper documents.

faq.question: Does it upload spreadsheet data?
faq.answer: No evidence found. The skill says formula clinic reports are local and asks for reduced public fixtures.

faq.question: What proof should an agent return?
faq.answer: It should return edited cells, before values, after values, recalculated outputs, and persistence evidence.

faq.question: Can it guarantee Excel compatibility?
faq.answer: No. It supports WorkPaper formulas and asks users to report unsupported formulas or Excel-only behavior.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
